targets.query: SELECT "run_number" FROM "dunedaq.drunc.opmon.RunInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND $timeFilter AND run_number>0
SELECT sum(data) FROM ( SELECT last("total_tps_received") AS data FROM "dunedaq.dfmodules.opmon.TPStreamWriterInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "element")
SELECT sum(data) FROM ( SELECT last("total_tps_written") AS data FROM "dunedaq.dfmodules.opmon.TPStreamWriterInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "element")

SELECT sum(data) FROM ( SELECT 100 * last("total_tps_discarded")/ last("total_tps_received") AS data FROM "dunedaq.dfmodules.opmon.TPStreamWriterInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND  total_tps_received>0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "element")

panels.description: Counters of the TP generated by the most active channels

targets.query: SELECT "element" AS "DLH", "channel", "number_of_tps" FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.TPChannelInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND "element" =~ /${DLH}/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: TP channel counters

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("number_of_tps")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.TPChannelInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~/${DLH}/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "channel" fill(null)

panels.description: This should only contain the rates for TP DLHs

targets.query: SELECT mean("rate_tp_hits")*1000 FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.HitFindingInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND "element" =~ /${DLH}/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element"

panels.title: Handlers - TP hit rates

panels.description: This should only contain the rates for TP DLHs

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_tps_sent")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.HitFindingInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND "element" =~ /${DLH}/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element"

panels.title: Handlers - TP Sent rates

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("number_of_tps")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.TPChannelInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~/${DLH}/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "channel" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("tps_received")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.dfmodules.opmon.TPStreamWriterInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element"

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("tps_written")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.dfmodules.opmon.TPStreamWriterInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element"

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("tpsets_with_tps_received")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.dfmodules.opmon.TPStreamWriterInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element"

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("timeslices_written")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.dfmodules.opmon.TPStreamWriterInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element"
SELECT max("tardy_timeslice_max_seconds") FROM "dunedaq.dfmodules.opmon.TPStreamWriterInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element"

panels.description: This should only contain the rates for TP DLHs

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_tps_send_failed")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.HitFindingInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND "element" =~ /${DLH}/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_tps_suppressed_too_long")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.HitFindingInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND "element" =~ /${DLH}/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval)

panels.title: Handlers - Total TP dropped rates

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_tps_send_failed")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.HitFindingInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND "element" =~ /${DLH}/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element"

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_tps_suppressed_too_long")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.HitFindingInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND "element" =~ /${DLH}/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element"

panels.title: Producers - TP Suppresed rates: too long

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("tps_discarded")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.dfmodules.opmon.TPStreamWriterInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "element", time($__interval)

SELECT sum(data) FROM ( SELECT last("total_tps_discarded") AS data FROM "dunedaq.dfmodules.opmon.TPStreamWriterInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "element", time($__interval) ) GROUP BY  time($__interval)

SELECT sum(data) FROM ( SELECT last("total_tps_discarded")/last("total_tps_received") AS data FROM "dunedaq.dfmodules.opmon.TPStreamWriterInfo" WHERE session='${session}' AND total_tps_discarded >0 AND  $timeFilter GROUP BY "element", time($__interval) ) GROUP BY  time($__interval)
